verifiedAgainst.note: Verified: the documented filename is CONVENTIONS.md, and it is not auto-discovered — it is loaded either by the `aider --read CONVENTIONS.md` flag or by a `read: CONVENTIONS.md` key in .aider.conf.yml, which also accepts a list. That non-discovery is the material difference from every other target here: emitting the file is not sufficient, so the profile records the config line a user still has to add.
